apis.save: save(prepared, route_result, validation_result, *, expected_save_store_pin, expected_parent_pin, run_id, handoff_id, expected_revision, expected_event_sha256, input_operation_key, validation_operation_key, save_operation_key, expected_candidate_sha256, expected_validation_receipt_sha256, authorize_save, authorize_read, save_content_for, manual_review, authorize_manual_review, manual_review_content_for, trusted_verifier_id, trusted_verifier_key, draft=None, allow_historical_proposal=False, approve_historical_proposal_metadata_save=False, acknowledge_partial_coverage=False, max_source_age_seconds=600)

source_chain: EC170 source-scoped permission and no unapproved source content
EC172 HMAC-sealed private stage with revision/event and parent pin
EC173 immutable HMAC-sealed input with exact source/evidence/material and TTL
EC174 dispatched callback candidate (schema_only is not a valid candidate)
EC175 independently reconstructed structural validation and pinned manual review

independent_authorization.store_init: approve_init=true on previously created empty owner-private directory, separate private parent
independent_authorization.save_permission: authorize_save=true; prior validation partial and SHA are NOT save grants
independent_authorization.source_permission: authorize_read=true and save_content_for matching exact EC173 source mode
independent_authorization.write_identity: save_operation_key distinct from input_operation_key and validation_operation_key
independent_authorization.target_identity: expected_save_store_pin bound to local store key, directory dev/ino/UID, absolute pathname, source stage dev/ino/path and business repo dev/ino/path
independent_authorization.validation_identity: expected_parent_pin, run_id, handoff_id, event SHA, revision, input and validate operation keys, separately pinned candidate SHA and original EC175 receipt SHA
independent_authorization.manual_review: all >=1 candidate findings must have signed confirm (never reject, inconclusive or missing) bound to EC175 validation operation and all original finding SHA, with authorize_manual_review=true, exact source and separately configured trusted HMAC verifier id/key
independent_authorization.proposed_pr: allow_historical_proposal=true AND approve_historical_proposal_metadata_save=true; is always historical and partial
independent_authorization.incomplete_source: acknowledge_partial_coverage=true independently, no promotion to complete
independent_authorization.read_record: new authorize_read=true plus exact source scope and store pin; no saved Finding reconstructed

confirmation_is_not: authenticated human identity or credential issuer
proof a software defect exists or AI output is correct
proof of real CI or test execution
live atomic Git source, remote repository or delivered state
authorization to write business files or issues
recheck_before_commit: ignore the unkeyed EC175 receipt as independent authorization
verify original exact v1 EC175 fields and separately pinned receipt digest
rerun EC175 source, route, draft, candidate, all original full-line anchors, HMAC input/stage, review signature, TTL, source-scoped grants
compare every stable field including proof/effects/coverage and manual review attestation against supplied result
require fresh complete per-finding confirmed declarations, no unreviewed/rejected/inconclusive
repeat entire fresh EC175 check after acquiring private store lock
bind save lifetime to min(original validation expiry, new validation expiry, signed manual review expiry)
scan and HMAC-validate all private records; fail if unknown entries, symlinks, hardlinks, malformed record or unfinished pending transaction

hashes: RunId/HandoffId/stage revision/event/source context and identity/evidence/material digests
candidate, normalized draft, EC174 route result digest
supplied and freshly rebuilt EC175 validation receipt digests
pinned separate reviewer attestation digest and verifier ID
input and validation operation digest and source stage parent pin digest
per-finding hashes only (no raw finding text)
source coverage canonical digest and conservative completeness/missing-requirements count
persistent_record.content: CES-owned metadata only; no CodeSave business source edits

disk_safety.supported: POSIX with secure no-follow directory FDs, flock, fsync and hardlink-if-absent; fail on unsupported OS/filesystem
disk_safety.directory: pre-provisioned owner 0700 root AND parent, pinned no symlink, strictly disjoint from EC172 store and business repo
disk_safety.permissions: 0600 exclusive regular one-link metadata files and private 32-byte random store key
disk_safety.publish: fsync temporary record, recheck pinned store/stage/repo roots, os.link no-clobber, fsync directory, remove temporary name, fsync directory
disk_safety.integrity: separate local HMAC-SHA256 per record and private manifest key binding; hashes alone do not confer authority
disk_safety.idempotency: same save operation and exact immutable stable content -> read-only original record with unchanged TTL; any conflict -> refuse; same candidate under a new save operation -> refuse
disk_safety.failure: unknown/pending files, hardlinks, symlinks, unsafe permissions or incomplete transaction block further use; post-link durability uncertainty explicitly reports unknown commit state and requires human examination
disk_safety.excluded: same-UID malicious process/key compromise, hostile OS, remote/filesystem atomic guarantee, crash/power-loss proof, cross-platform validation

status_and_exit.successful_metadata_save_or_idempotent_r: partial/2 (metadata commit is real, candidate semantics not proven)

cli.save: Python API ONLY with in-memory externally pinned manual key; no secret-key CLI flags
cli.output: init/inspect counts or explicitly scoped HMAC metadata; not model/source text
